comparisons.title: Drift track: diagnostic colours to source textures
comparisons.caption: The first Rust and wgpu frame used flat diagnostic colours. The current frame combines masks and four source detail textures per material. Lighting, shadows and normal maps are still missing.

comparisons.title: Magione: composed models to multilayer materials
comparisons.caption: Eight textures exceeded the decoded-texture budget in the first composition. Direct BC uploads and the multilayer formula restored road and grass colour.

comparisons.title: BMW M3 E30 on Drift: standing, then driving
comparisons.caption: The same fixed camera before and after the scripted drive. The coupled Rust chassis, suspension, wheel spin and rack steering move the car.
